&nbsp;Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)

Job Summary


	The Procurement Officer will manage the sourcing and purchasing of goods, equipment, materials, and services required for the efficient operation of the retail, hospitality, leisure, food and beverage, and administrative departments.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement procurement procedures, policies, and approval processes.
	Source reliable suppliers, vendors, contractors, and service providers.
	Obtain and evaluate quotations, proposals, and supplier bids.
	Negotiate competitive prices, payment terms, delivery timelines, and service agreements.
	Prepare purchase orders and ensure all purchases receive the necessary approvals.
	Procure food items, beverages, retail products, maintenance materials, office supplies, equipment, and operational consumables.
	Work closely with the hypermarket, waterpark, food and beverage, kitchen, maintenance, finance, and administrative teams.
	Monitor supplier performance, product quality, pricing, and delivery timelines.
	Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier databases, contracts, invoices, and purchase documentation.
	Coordinate with inventory and store teams to maintain appropriate stock levels.
	Prevent over-purchasing, shortages, wastage, and unauthorised purchases.
	Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, budgets, and ethical standards.
	Conduct regular market research to identify better products, prices, and suppliers.
	Prepare procurement, cost-saving, supplier-performance, and expenditure reports for management.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s degree or HND in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, inventory, retail, hospitality, construction, or facility operations.
	Strong knowledge of vendor sourcing, quotation analysis, contract negotiation, and purchase-order management.
	Experience purchasing for a supermarket, hotel, restaurant, waterpark, mall, or mixed-use facility will be an added advantage.
	Strong negotiation, communication, analytical, and record-keeping skills.
	High level of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, inventory systems, and procurement software.
	Must be able to work effectively with multiple departments and meet tight procurement deadlines.
	Experience in 4 star /5 star Hospitality industry is compulsory


General Requirements:


	Candidates must be professional, responsible, and customer-focused.
	Applicants should demonstrate strong teamwork and communication skills.
	Relevant experience in 4 - 5 star hospitality, retail, leisure, or mixed-use commercial facilities is compulsory.
	Candidates must be willing to work in Abuja.
	Only qualified and experienced applicants should apply.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief cover letter to: sevicrecruit@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Procurement Officer Job at Sevic Recruit




        
    

        
        Sevic Recruit - Our client, a fast-growing mixed-use commercial and leisure destination in Abuja is recruiting experienced professionals to join its operations and pre-opening team in the capacity below:

 Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)

Job Summary


	The Procurement Officer will manage the sourcing and purchasing of goods, equipment, materials, and services required for the efficient operation of the retail, hospitality, leisure, food and beverage, and administrative departments.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Develop and implement procurement procedures, policies, and approval processes.
	Source reliable suppliers, vendors, contractors, and service providers.
	Obtain and evaluate quotations, proposals, and supplier bids.
	Negotiate competitive prices, payment terms, delivery timelines, and service agreements.
	Prepare purchase orders and ensure all purchases receive the necessary approvals.
	Procure food items, beverages, retail products, maintenance materials, office supplies, equipment, and operational consumables.
	Work closely with the hypermarket, waterpark, food and beverage, kitchen, maintenance, finance, and administrative teams.
	Monitor supplier performance, product quality, pricing, and delivery timelines.
	Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier databases, contracts, invoices, and purchase documentation.
	Coordinate with inventory and store teams to maintain appropriate stock levels.
	Prevent over-purchasing, shortages, wastage, and unauthorised purchases.
	Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, budgets, and ethical standards.
	Conduct regular market research to identify better products, prices, and suppliers.
	Prepare procurement, cost-saving, supplier-performance, and expenditure reports for management.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree or HND in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, inventory, retail, hospitality, construction, or facility operations.
	Strong knowledge of vendor sourcing, quotation analysis, contract negotiation, and purchase-order management.
	Experience purchasing for a supermarket, hotel, restaurant, waterpark, mall, or mixed-use facility will be an added advantage.
	Strong negotiation, communication, analytical, and record-keeping skills.
	High level of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, inventory systems, and procurement software.
	Must be able to work effectively with multiple departments and meet tight procurement deadlines.
	Experience in 4 star /5 star Hospitality industry is compulsory


General Requirements:


	Candidates must be professional, responsible, and customer-focused.
	Applicants should demonstrate strong teamwork and communication skills.
	Relevant experience in 4 - 5 star hospitality, retail, leisure, or mixed-use commercial facilities is compulsory.
	Candidates must be willing to work in Abuja.
	Only qualified and experienced applicants should apply.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Inventory Manager Job at Audacious Circle Careers




        
    

        
        Audacious Circle Careers was founded with a singular conviction: that Africa's organisations deserve a talent partner as ambitious as their vision. We exist at the intersection of consulting rigour and human empathy — combining data-driven methodology with a genuine commitment to the people and businesses we serve.

From our headquarters in Lagos, we've grown into a trusted partner to 500+ organisations and 5,000+ professionals across the continent. Our approach rejects the transactional nature of traditional recruitment in favour of strategic, long-term partnerships that create enduring value.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for an experienced Inventory Manager to oversee and optimize inventory operations across our warehousing and distribution network.
	The ideal candidate will ensure accurate stock records, maintain optimal inventory levels, minimize losses, and implement effective inventory control processes to support efficient business operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement inventory control policies and procedures.
	Monitor inventory levels to ensure adequate stock availability while minimizing excess inventory.
	Oversee stock receiving, storage, transfers, and dispatch processes.
	Conduct regular cycle counts and periodic stock audits to ensure inventory accuracy.
	Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, variances, and stock losses.
	Reconcile physical inventory with system records and prepare variance reports.
	Monitor inventory turnover and recommend strategies to improve stock movement.
	Collaborate with procurement, warehouse, finance, and operations teams to ensure seamless inventory management.
	Generate and analyze inventory reports to support management decision-making.
	Ensure proper documentation of inventory transactions and compliance with company policies.
	Supervise and mentor inventory personnel to improve team performance.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance inventory accuracy and operational efficiency.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in inventory management within a warehousing, logistics, FMCG, manufacturing, or distribution company.
	Strong knowledge of inventory control principles and warehouse operations.
	Experience using ERP, WMS, or inventory management systems.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
	Excellent leadership and team management abilities.
	High attention to detail with the ability to work under pressure.


Key Competencies:


	Inventory Control & Management
	Warehouse Operations
	Stock Auditing & Reconciliation
	Inventory Forecasting
	ERP/WMS Proficiency
	Data Analysis & Reporting
	Process Improvement
	Leadership & Team Management
	Problem-Solving
	Time Management
	Attention to Detail.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary
	Career growth and development opportunities
	Collaborative work environment
	Ongoing learning and professional training.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Inventory Manager" as the subject of the email.

Credit Officer Job at StaggaPay




        
    

        
        StaggaPay is a fast-growing fintech startup dedicated to providing accessible and innovative financing solutions in Nigeria. We leverage cutting-edge technology to simplify lending, ensuring our clients can access the funds they need with speed and transparency. As we scale, we are looking for meticulous and driven individuals to join our Operations Team.

At StaggaPay, we aren't just lending money; we are putting people behind the wheel of their dreams and livelihoods.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Credit Officer
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Assess applicants' creditworthiness by evaluating income, financial behaviour, repayment capacity, and potential risks.
	Conduct interviews with applicants and guarantors to verify information and support sound credit decisions.
	Collect, verify, and maintain accurate KYC documentation in line with regulatory and company requirements.
	Carry out residential and field verification visits, documenting findings, risk indicators, and environmental assessments.
	Prepare clear credit assessment reports and recommendations for approval.
	Accurately upload client information into the loan origination system and ensure high-quality data integrity.


Required Qualifications & Experience


	Possess a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field with 2 – 3 years of experience in credit assessment, microfinance, asset or vehicle finance, or a similar lending environment.
	Good understanding of credit analysis, affordability assessments, and KYC requirements.
	Experience conducting field verification is an added advantage.
	Willingness to travel regularly for field verification and client assessments.


Remuneration


	We offer a competitive salary (based on experience) + performance incentives.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV  to: [email protected] using "CO (preferred LGA)" as the subject of the email.

Procurement Officer Job at Mao-Oak Resources Limited




        
    

        
        Mao-Oak Resources Limited, incorporated in 2017, is wholly Nigerian company strategically positioned to offer Oil & Gas Services, Turnkey Project Consultancy, Offshore Safety, General Procurement and Marine Fire Solutions with key expertise across Marine, Oil & Gas and Aviation Operations. We collaborate with a global network of strategic partners to seamlessly deploy cutting-edge technologies, ensuring innovative solutions and guaranteed client satisfaction.

Since more than 7 years in Nigeria, and with permanent facility in Port-Harcourt, Mao-Oak Resource Ltd combines its multidisciplinary expertise, mobilization capacity on appropriate infrastructures and innovative equipment to provide integrated solutions, always with a local content optimization approach.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Are you an organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven professional with a passion for procurement and supply chain management?. 
	We are looking for a dedicated Procurement Officer to join our team and contribute to business growth through efficient sourcing, vendor management, and strategic purchasing.


Key Responsibilities


	Source and procure goods and services in line with company requirements.
	Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers to ensure best value.
	Maintain and update procurement records, contracts, and supplier databases.
	Prepare and submit procurement reports and documentation.
	Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely delivery and compliance with quality standards.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree with 2–5 years of proven experience in procurement or supply chain roles.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Self-driven, detail-oriented, and target-focused.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools. Basic knowledge of procurement software (Ariba, SAP) is an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Procurement Officer" as the subject of the mail.
